name: Dark Pewee
rangeDescription: Montane forest of costa rica and far western panama (chiriquí)
description: The only all-dark crested flycatcher in range. Entirely sooty-gray, only slightly paler on throat and belly.

name: Seram Myzomela
rangeDescription: Southern moluccas (seram, ambon, and boano)
description: A small, drab brown songbird with an entirely blackish downcurved bill and subtle scaling on the throat. Restricted to Seram, Boano, and Ambon islands.

name: Bryan's Shearwater
rangeDescription: Range poorly known; discovered on midway island (hawaii), but probably breeds bonin islands (japan)
description: Smallest known shearwater. Tiny, black and white shearwater with rapidly fluttering wingbeats and an entirely white face.

name: Oriole Cuckooshrike
rangeDescription: Southern cameroon to southwestern central african republic, eastern democratic republic of the congo, and gabon
description: A spectacular cuckooshrike that resembles an oriole, with a yellow-green back, wings and tail, yellow underparts, a dark head and bill, and large fleshy orange wattles under the eyes. The sexes differ slightly: the head of the male is jet black and the female has a less contrasting brownish head.

name: Yellow-throated Tanager
rangeDescription: Andes of southeastern colombia to ecuador and southeastern peru (puno)
description: A well-named and colorful tanager found in cloud forest along the east slope of the Andes. Blazing yellow throat stands out sharply against its otherwise mostly bluish plumage.

name: Sagebrush Sparrow
rangeDescription: Sagebrush and saltbush of great basin
description: Pale, subtly-patterned sparrow. Sandy-brown overall with gray head and whitish breast with dark central spotting.

name: Makira Cicadabird
rangeDescription: Makira (southeastern solomon islands)
description: Male is light powder-gray with darker wing feathers and tail and a dark patch in front of the eye. Female is powder-gray above and vivid reddish below.

name: White-eared Solitaire
rangeDescription: East slope of andes of peru and western bolivia (la paz and cochabamba)
description: Beautiful, boldly patterned bird of montane forest. Reddish brown above, black below, with a black head, broad white mustache, and coral red bill.

name: Fulvous-headed Brushfinch
rangeDescription: Andes of central bolivia from cochabamba southward to northwestern argentina
description: Colorful brushfinch of upper humid montane forest and open humid scrubland in the Andes from NW Argentina to central Bolivia. Superficially similar to Rust-and-yellow Tanager, but note contrasting yellow malar and lores.

name: Pink-necked Green-Pigeon
rangeDescription: Southeastern asia to philippines and indonesia
description: Brightly-colored tree-dwelling pigeon. Adult male has a powder-pink neck, orange breast patch, gray-blue head, and yellow belly.

name: Red-chested Sunbird
rangeDescription: South sudan, eastern democratic republic of the congo, uganda, southwestern kenya, rwanda, burundi, and northwestern tanzania
description: A slim, curve-billed sunbird in which males and females are very different. Males are mostly black and dark green, with a red band across the underparts and elongated central tail feathers.

name: Olive Honeyeater
rangeDescription: Moluccas and raja ampat islands (off western new guinea)
description: A nondescript sparrow-sized songbird with a slender, downcurved bill. Entirely olive-green above and uniform pale gray below, but note head pattern, which includes a prominent whitish smudge on the cheeks and dull bare skin below the eye.

name: Black-chinned Hummingbird
rangeDescription: Breeds drier parts of southern british columbia to northwestern mexico; winters to southern mexico
description: Small hummingbird found in a variety of woodland and brushy habitats. Male distinctive with purple-and-black throat.

name: Brown-breasted Kingfisher
rangeDescription: Philippines
description: A fairly large kingfisher of lowland and foothill open country and forest edge. Chocolate brown on the underparts and hood, down to the upper back.

name: White-naped Lory
rangeDescription: New ireland (northeastern bismarck archipelago)
description: A thick-set, short-tailed parrot with green wings, a red body, and a black cap. White patch on back of head is diagnostic but often difficult to observe.

name: Atlantic Plain-Xenops
rangeDescription: Eastern brazil (north to southern bahia) to eastern paraguay and northeastern argentina
description: Active small bird of humid tropical forest. Usually found singly, often moving with mixed-species feeding flocks.

name: Pied Bronze-Cuckoo
rangeDescription: Moluccas (tayandu and kai islands) and tanimbar islands (yamdena and larat)
description: Striking small cuckoo endemic to the Tanimbar, and Kai and Tayando Islands (where rare) of the southeastern Moluccas. Male is dark iridescent green above and white below, with a bright red patch of bare facial skin around each eye, and a large white wing patch.

name: Rosy Minivet
rangeDescription: Himalayas (afghanistan to southwestern china, myanmar, and northern india) to southern china, myanmar, and northwestern vietnam
description: Pale, rather washed-out-looking minivet. Male has a white throat, pink breast, and bright red “apostrophe” on the wing.

name: Rachel's Malimbe
rangeDescription: Lowland forest of southeastern nigeria to southern cameroon and gabon
description: A beautiful malimbe locally distributed in Central Africa and restricted to lowland primary forest and its edges, where it is often found high above the ground in small groups or with mixed-species flocks, sometimes with other species of malimbe. Both males and females are wholly black with yellow vents and orange chests that fade to yellow at the edges.

name: White-browed Meadowlark
rangeDescription: Far southeastern peru to paraguay, uruguay, northern argentina, and brazil
description: Medium-sized blackbird found in wet grasslands and agricultural areas. Males are striking with a narrow white eyebrow, a mostly black body, and a brilliant red breast and shoulders patches.
